sam_prologue_01.speaker: SAM
sam_prologue_01.text: Welcome, specialist. I'm Sam, your flight director here on Earth.

sam_prologue_02.speaker: SAM
sam_prologue_02.text: Robots on the Moon and Mars are getting things ready for the next astronauts.

sam_prologue_03.speaker: SAM
sam_prologue_03.text: But four of them stopped sending signals. We don't know why yet.

sam_prologue_04.speaker: SAM
sam_prologue_04.text: You're our robot specialist. Your job: find them and fix them.

sam_prologue_05.speaker: SAM
sam_prologue_05.text: First stop: the Moon. Let's see what you learned in training.

sam_moon_arrival_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_arrival_01.text: Moon base online. Our signal delay is only 1.3 seconds.

sam_moon_arrival_02.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_arrival_02.text: That means I can help you almost live. Let's use it!

sam_moon_energy_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_energy_01.text: Every day starts with energy. Split it between life support, radio and shielding.

sam_moon_energy_02.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_energy_02.text: Up here, nothing is free. Everything you do costs something.

sam_moon_energy_03.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_energy_03.text: Try giving life support the most. Your crew needs air and water first. Don't forget the oxygen.

sam_moon_cables_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_cables_01.text: Moon dust is sharp and sticky. It's covering the cables in your solar panels.

sam_moon_cables_02.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_cables_02.text: Connect the cables to fix them. Working panels make more energy.

sam_moon_antenna_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_antenna_01.text: Your oxygen tank fills when you are inside the station.

sam_moon_antenna_02.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_antenna_02.text: I hear a weak signal. Point the antenna at it.

sam_moon_antenna_03.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_antenna_03.text: Tilt to steer. Driving uses energy, so take the short way.

sam_moon_antenna_04.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_antenna_04.text: When the signal turns green, hold still.

sam_moon_antenna_05.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_antenna_05.text: Got it! That's Pragyan. Take the rover and go find it.

sam_moon_repair_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_repair_01.text: There it is. Open its file and let's see what's wrong.

sam_moon_repair_02.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_repair_02.text: Let's connect the cables and point the panel so it faces the sun.

sam_moon_repair_03.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_repair_03.text: It's beeping again! Great work, specialist.

sam_moon_repair_04.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_repair_04.text: Pragyan gave you something for your trip: an extra battery.

sam_moon_close_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_close_01.text: Did you know? On the Moon, the Sun stays up for about two weeks. Then it's night for two weeks.

sam_moon_close_02.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_close_02.text: Can you imagine how a base could stay warm during that long night?

sam_moon_pack_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_pack_01.text: You're ready for Mars. Pack your energy, water and air for the trip.

sam_moon_pack_02.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_pack_02.text: This time your crew will be with you.

sam_moon_pack_03.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_pack_03.text: Pack too little and you'll arrive short. Pack too much and the ship gets heavy.

sam_trip_01.speaker: SAM
sam_trip_01.text: Mars is far. The trip takes months, so we'll skip to the good part.

sam_trip_02.speaker: SAM
sam_trip_02.text: Tilt to keep the ship on its path. Every fix uses a little fuel.

sam_trip_03.speaker: SAM
sam_trip_03.text: One more thing. From now on, my messages will take minutes to reach you.

sam_trip_04.speaker: SAM
sam_trip_04.text: But don't worry, you won't be alone. The base AI will help you. Good luck, specialist.

pip_arrival_01.speaker: PIP
pip_arrival_01.text: Hi, specialist! I'm your Planetary Interface Partner, but you can call me PIP. I run the base, watch the oxygen and tell jokes.

pip_arrival_02.speaker: PIP
pip_arrival_02.text: Two of those I'm very good at.

pip_arrival_03.speaker: PIP
pip_arrival_03.text: Welcome to Mars! Here a day is called a sol. It lasts 24 hours and 39 minutes.

pip_arrival_04.speaker: PIP
pip_arrival_04.text: This is your crew. They count on you for air, water and food from the greenhouse.

pip_arrival_05.speaker: PIP
pip_arrival_05.text: Three robots on Mars stopped talking. Sam sent their files. You pick who to help first.

pip_arrival_06.speaker: PIP
pip_arrival_06.text: Tip: tap the robot and read each file. It says how that robot can help us.

sam_arrival_msg_01.speaker: SAM
sam_arrival_msg_01.text: You made it! I can't answer fast anymore. Trust PIP, and trust yourself.

pip_arrival_msg_02.speaker: PIP
pip_arrival_msg_02.text: So basically if I tell Sam a joke now, Sam laughs in a few minutes. Which is still worth it.

sam_missionA_alert_01.speaker: SAM
sam_missionA_alert_01.text: Curiosity went quiet after a big solar storm.

sam_missionA_alert_02.speaker: SAM
sam_missionA_alert_02.text: Another storm may be coming. Check DONKI before you go outside.

pip_missionA_alert_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_alert_03.text: DONKI is NASA's space weather database. It tracks storms that come from the Sun.

pip_missionA_prep_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_prep_01.text: Here on Mars, we must be careful when going outside.

pip_missionA_prep_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_prep_02.text: Let's check the forecast on DONKI.

pip_missionA_prep_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_prep_03.text: Solar storm ahead. Good thing I wear sunscreen. ...I'm a computer. I don't.

pip_missionA_prep_04.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_prep_04.text: Mars has very thin air and no magnetic shield like Earth's. More radiation gets through.

pip_missionA_prep_05.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_prep_05.text: Let's make our shielding stronger before we leave.

pip_missionA_prep_06.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_prep_06.text: Tip: shielding costs energy. Do it the sol before the storm.

pip_missionA_exit_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_exit_01.text: The storm passed. It's safe to drive now.

pip_missionA_exit_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_exit_02.text: Mars dust gets everywhere. I found some in my code.

pip_missionA_exit_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_exit_03.text: Here's Curiosity. Its file says: a solar storm scrambled its computer and left it in safe mode. Let's fix it.

pip_missionA_repair_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_repair_01.text: Connect the device to the robot to access the terminal.

pip_missionA_repair_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_repair_02.text: Curiosity uses 2 computers. Stop the broken one, and start the other computer.

pip_missionA_reward_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionA_reward_01.text: Curiosity is back! It will warn us about storms one sol earlier.

sam_missionA_reward_02.speaker: SAM
sam_missionA_reward_02.text: Checking the forecast was the right call. Real teams do it every day.

sam_missionA_reward_03.speaker: SAM
sam_missionA_reward_03.text: Did you know? Earth's magnetic field blocks a lot of space radiation. Mars doesn't have one like it.

sam_missionA_reward_04.speaker: SAM
sam_missionA_reward_04.text: Do you think that's what makes the northern lights on Earth?

sam_missionB_alert_01.speaker: SAM
sam_missionB_alert_01.text: Phoenix was searching for ice under the ground. Then it stopped.

sam_missionB_alert_02.speaker: SAM
sam_missionB_alert_02.text: Your crew needs water too. Keep the tanks full before you go.

pip_missionB_prep_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_prep_01.text: We can recycle water or dig for ice. Recycling costs less. Ice gives more.

pip_missionB_prep_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_prep_02.text: This water has been recycled so many times, it deserves a medal.

pip_missionB_prep_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_prep_03.text: Remember: the greenhouse needs water too. No water, no salad.

pip_missionB_prep_04.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_prep_04.text: Tip: keep life support above half before you drive out.

pip_missionB_exit_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_exit_01.text: Here's Phoenix. Its file says: hard ice jammed its scoop, and sticky dirt clogged its oven screen. Let's fix it.

pip_missionB_reward_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_reward_01.text: Phoenix found ice again! We'll get extra water every sol.

pip_missionB_reward_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_reward_02.text: Fresh lettuce on Mars! Lettuce celebrate.

sam_missionB_reward_04.speaker: SAM
sam_missionB_reward_04.text: Did you know? The Space Station recycles about 98 of every 100 drops of water.

sam_missionB_reward_05.speaker: SAM
sam_missionB_reward_05.text: Can you find out where Mars keeps its ice? It could be useful in future missions.

sam_missionC_alert_01.speaker: SAM
sam_missionC_alert_01.text: A dust storm is covering the sky. Opportunity went dark, and your panels are getting weak.

sam_missionC_alert_02.speaker: SAM
sam_missionC_alert_02.text: Keep the base warm first. Then go find Opportunity.

pip_missionC_prep_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_prep_01.text: Sunlight on Mars is less than half as strong as on Earth. With dust, it's even weaker.

pip_missionC_prep_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_prep_02.text: We can repair the panels, or start the small reactor. The reactor takes two sols.

pip_missionC_prep_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_prep_03.text: I'm not lazy. I'm in power-saving mode.

pip_missionC_prep_04.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_prep_04.text: Tip: start the reactor early. It's slow, but it works in any weather.

pip_missionC_exit_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_exit_01.text: Here's Opportunity. Its file says: a dust storm covered its solar panels.

pip_missionC_exit_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_exit_02.text: Have you tried turning it off and on again? Oh wait. That's literally our job.

pip_missionC_reward_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_reward_01.text: Opportunity is online! The base gets extra energy every sol.

sam_missionC_reward_02.speaker: SAM
sam_missionC_reward_02.text: Did you know? NASA is working on small nuclear reactors to power future bases on the Moon and Mars.

sam_missionC_reward_03.speaker: SAM
sam_missionC_reward_03.text: Can you imagine how long the biggest dust storms on Mars can last?

pip_alert_energy.speaker: PIP
pip_alert_energy.text: Energy is getting low. Let's save some for tonight.

pip_alert_lifesupport.speaker: PIP
pip_alert_lifesupport.text: Air and water are dropping. The crew needs you to fix that first.

pip_alert_shield.speaker: PIP
pip_alert_shield.text: Our shielding is weak. Maybe stay inside until we fix it.

pip_alert_food.speaker: PIP
pip_alert_food.text: Food is running low. The greenhouse needs water to grow more.

pip_rescue_01_lifesupport.speaker: PIP
pip_rescue_01_lifesupport.text: Uh-oh. We ran out of air and water.

pip_rescue_01_food.speaker: PIP
pip_rescue_01_food.text: Uh-oh. We ran out of food.

pip_rescue_01_shield.speaker: PIP
pip_rescue_01_shield.text: Uh-oh. We ran out of shielding.

pip_rescue_02.speaker: PIP
pip_rescue_02.text: The crew shared their reserves to help us. We lost a sol, but everyone is okay.

pip_rescue_03.speaker: PIP
pip_rescue_03.text: Let's plan a little better this time. You've got this!

pip_commander_01_lifesupport.speaker: PIP
pip_commander_01_lifesupport.text: We had to bring the crew inside. Here's what happened: the air and water ran out before we could refill them.

pip_commander_01_food.speaker: PIP
pip_commander_01_food.text: We had to bring the crew inside. Here's what happened: the crew ate more than the greenhouse could grow.

pip_commander_01_shield.speaker: PIP
pip_commander_01_shield.text: We had to bring the crew inside. Here's what happened: the shielding got too low, and too much radiation got through.

pip_commander_02.speaker: PIP
pip_commander_02.text: Every astronaut learns from a tough sol. Want to try again?

pip_final_01.speaker: PIP
pip_final_01.text: That's all of them, specialist! Every robot is talking again.

sam_final_02.speaker: SAM
sam_final_02.text: Specialist, we got signals from all four robots. Everyone here is cheering.

sam_final_03.speaker: SAM
sam_final_03.text: Thanks to you, the next crew can come to Mars. You're not a cadet anymore.

pip_final_04.speaker: PIP
pip_final_04.text: I'd hug you, but I don't have arms. Consider this a virtual hug.

pip_final_05.speaker: PIP
pip_final_05.text: Want to try a different order? Or switch to Commander mode?

pip_missionB_mg1_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_mg1_01.text: Hard ice is stuck in Phoenix's scoop.

pip_missionB_mg1_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_mg1_02.text: Tap the ice and dirt with the hammer to break them off!

pip_missionB_mg1_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_mg1_03.text: Tip: ice needs 3 hits. Dirt needs only 1.

pip_missionB_mg2_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_mg2_01.text: Sticky dirt is clogging Phoenix's oven screen.

pip_missionB_mg2_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_mg2_02.text: Tap fast, press SPACE, or shake your device to clean it!

pip_missionB_mg2_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionB_mg2_03.text: The real Phoenix team shook its screen for several days.

pip_missionC_mg1_01.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_mg1_01.text: Dust is covering Opportunity's solar panels.

pip_missionC_mg1_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_mg1_02.text: Hold and swipe over the panels to brush the dust away!

pip_missionC_mg1_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_mg1_03.text: Tip: just clicking won't work. You have to swipe.

pip_missionC_mg2_02.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_mg2_02.text: Drag each cable to the socket of the same color!

pip_missionC_mg2_03.speaker: PIP
pip_missionC_mg2_03.text: Tip: each cable and socket has a letter too.

sam_moon_keys_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_keys_01.text: Grab the rover keys. Let's go find that signal.

sam_moon_reward_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_reward_01.text: Pragyan gave you something for your trip.

sam_moon_reward_02.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_reward_02.text: An extra battery! You'll need it on Mars.

sam_moon_split_01.speaker: SAM
sam_moon_split_01.text: Practice time! Tap + and - to share 10 energy.

pip_split_01.speaker: PIP
pip_split_01.text: A new sol! Let's share today's energy.

pip_split_food_warn.speaker: PIP
pip_split_food_warn.text: Food only grows if air & water is 20 or more!

pip_report_ok.speaker: PIP
pip_report_ok.text: Good job! The crew is safe for now.

pip_report_waste.speaker: PIP
pip_report_waste.text: Some sunlight was wasted. Use your energy or lose it!

pip_report_storm.speaker: PIP
pip_report_storm.text: A storm hit our shield. DONKI can warn us next time.

pip_report_low.speaker: PIP
pip_report_low.text: Something is running low. Give it more energy today!

pip_rescue_once.speaker: PIP
pip_rescue_once.text: The crew can only do this once. Let's be careful!

pip_rescue_none.speaker: PIP
pip_rescue_none.text: Oh no. The crew has no reserves left to share.

pip_time_up.speaker: PIP
pip_time_up.text: Our time on Mars is over. Let's see what we fixed!
